newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks mixed but mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks mixed but mostly steady.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Friday was still confused with the trend difficult to identify although most shares were steady.
Total volume on the official list was 59.1 million kroons and the index closed up 0.70 percent at 262.26.
"Dealers are not sure how to read the market as yet but investors are not rushing to sell," one trader said.
"It seems that buying pressure will remain into next week and the whole market will be watching big banking stocks for signs of movement to help pick the market direction," he added.

The banks have now begun to report their quarterly results and Hansapank, the largest in Estonia, announced after the market closed that its first quarter 1997 profit soared 163 percent to 96.4 million kroons.
Hansapank rose before the results news to make up most of Thursday's loss of 5.00 kroons to end up four kroons at 264.00. The stock registered trade of 5.5 million kroons of shares.
Forekspank was strongly traded with 28.4 million kroons of shares turned over to close 1.45 kroons higher on 196.05 kroons.
"The price hit a high of 199 kroons and also saw a low of 184, so people were not sure how to call it," one trader said.
Hoiupank closed on 133.40 down 1.60 kroons to close after a trade of 9.5 million kroons.
On the free market, total trade was 10 million kroons of shares, with Kalev confectioner the most active stock.
Kalev picked up 20 kroons to close 1850.00 kroons with 3.6 million kroons of shares changing hands.
"This and other free market stocks will follow whatever direction the (official) market trends takes into next week with all eyes on Hansapank and Hoiupank," another trader said.
